\begin{abstractbox}

\begin{abstract}
\parttitle{Background}
Readmission after heart failure is frequent.

\parttitle{Methods}
We randomised 600 patients to telemonitoring or usual care.

\parttitle{Results}
Telemonitoring reduced readmission ($\HR = 0.78$).
\end{abstract}

\begin{keyword}
\kwd{heart failure}
\kwd{telemonitoring}
\kwd{randomised trial}
\end{keyword}

\end{abstractbox}

\end{frontmatter}

\section*{Background}

Heart failure readmissions are costly \cite{knuth}.

\section*{Methods}

Patients were followed for a year \cite{lamport}.

\section*{Results}
